Record Class User

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
edu.tamu.csce331.squad23.model.User
Record Components:
id - database id
storeId - id of the Store the employee works at
username - login name, unique across all users
passwordHash - stored password hash; new employees get the placeholder UpdateRequired
firstName - first name; may be null
lastName - last name; may be null
role - manager or cashier; may be null
createdAt - when the account was created
updatedAt - when the account was last changed
lastLoginAt - when the employee last logged in; not yet updated by the app, so currently equals the account's creation time.
public record User(long id, long storeId, String username, String passwordHash, String firstName, String lastName, String role, OffsetDateTime createdAt, OffsetDateTime updatedAt, OffsetDateTime lastLoginAt) extends Record
An employee account, one row of the users table.
